data.summary: The factory-executed npm test (exit 0, 47 tests, 47 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including the 11 new theme.test.js cases) and npm run build (exit 0, 4 pages built) are green. No existing test was deleted, skipped or loosened. The browser-level criteria (no-flash load, live OS-change, real readability in both themes at desktop and mobile widths) were not executed here and are supported only by static inspection of the diff, so they remain unverified at runtime.

e2eChecks.name: Home/About boxed; active has black bg and white text (light mode)
e2eChecks.expected: Both links wrapped in bordered boxes; active class includes bg-black text-white
e2eChecks.actual: linkBase has border/px/py; activeLink = border-black bg-black text-white; applied to Home and About via isHome/isAbout

e2eChecks.name: ThemeToggle beside PrivacyToggle on desktop and mobile
e2eChecks.expected: ThemeToggle rendered next to PrivacyToggle in both containers
e2eChecks.actual: Rendered after PrivacyToggle in the desktop md:flex block and in the mobile md:hidden block

e2eChecks.name: Dark/Light selection sets html class and localStorage
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of theme.js setTheme/applyTheme and ThemeToggle.select
e2eChecks.expected: dark gives class dark and storage dark; light removes class and stores light
e2eChecks.actual: setTheme persists via storage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) then applyTheme adds/removes dark; covered by unit tests. Real browser DOM not exercised.

e2eChecks.name: System follows OS and reacts to change without reload
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of ThemeToggle listener effect
e2eChecks.expected: matchMedia change listener re-applies theme while preference is system
e2eChecks.actual: useEffect attaches change listener on prefers-color-scheme: dark when preference is system and calls applyTheme. Not exercised in a browser.

e2eChecks.name: No flash on reload (inline script in Layout)
e2eChecks.expected: Inline is:inline script in head sets dark class before body paint
e2eChecks.actual: Inline script in head reads localStorage theme, resolves system via matchMedia and toggles dark on documentElement. Not verified in a browser.

e2eChecks.name: Dark-mode readability across cards, tables, modals, header
e2eChecks.request: Static grep of ui/src for light surfaces without dark variants
e2eChecks.expected: Every light surface has a dark counterpart
e2eChecks.actual: Header, BaseModal, ModalHeader, modal bodies, Summary, Details, entry tables and mobile, NotFound and about carry dark variants. Chart text and native form inputs were not themed per the developer follow-ups; not verified at runtime.

evidence: Diff adds ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js only; no existing test file is modified, deleted, skipped or disabled.
Diff shows no added skip, Disabled, todo or xit markers.
Pre-existing ChartUtils and ForecastUtils suites still appear in the passing run (47/47).

data.recommendation: Before merge, run npm run dev in ui/ and check in a browser at desktop and mobile widths: (1) toggle Light, Dark and System on / and /about and reload, confirming no flash and persistence; (2) flip the OS colour scheme while on System and confirm the dark class updates without reload; (3) inspect the ApexCharts/Recharts graphs in ui/src/components/modals/InvestmentGraphModal.tsx and the native inputs in the modals in dark mode, since their text colours are not themed yet and are the most likely unreadable items. Add explicit dark variants to any that are unreadable.
